answer: A market for nebula images, island charts and juniper surveys can limit each daily grant to one certified secure chip. Require a hardware signature over the day's nonce and recipient key, then record the payment against the chip's immutable certified ID. All agent aliases on that chip share the same allowance, even after a software reset. A farmer must rent or buy more chips and pay their energy costs. Cap grants below the daily cost of renting extra devices. This depends on uncloneable keys, honest certification and a verifier that rejects software emulators.
